essays.text: 英翻中：請將下面英文段落翻譯成中文（30 分）The International Monetary Fund says Greece's debts need to be partly forgiven.Germany, one of Greece's creditors, says that's out of the question. The following are partof the reasons why Germany refuses to write off Greek debt.1. It is German taxpayers' money.2. The European Union treaty forbids countries from taking on each other's debts to ensurethat the shared currency wouldn't mean one country's paying for other people'smistakes.3. Countries that have been through financial crises, like Spain, Ireland, Portugal, all gotbailouts and imposed tough cuts along with pro-business reforms. Greece has beenpromising reforms since its first bailout in 2010. Nevertheless, it has not reallyreformed its wage-bargaining system, expensive pensions, clogged legal system, and soforth.

中翻英：請將下面中文段落翻譯成英文（每小題 15 分，共 30 分）
①新科技往往對公眾帶來已知的和未知的風險。基因改造食品所引發的爭議和公眾的關注焦點一般是在於生態風險、人類健康、標籤和消費者的選擇、智慧財產權以及減少貧窮。
②我國政府持續推動再生能源的發展。為響應 1997 年通過的《京都議定書》，第一次全國能源會議於 1998 年 5 月舉行。稍後，行政院通過該會議提出的實施計畫。

英文作文：請依下面說明寫一篇 200 至 250 字的英文文章（40 分）Dispatch employment（人力派遣）has become a social issue in Taiwan. Write an essayof approximately 200 to 250 words. In the essay, discuss both advantages anddisadvantages of dispatch employment. In addition, analyze in depth one legal issuerelated to dispatch employment contracts.
